dialogue.text: Between Gera and Altenberg it stands, rather inconspicuous but full of history, posterstein castle.
dialogue.zh: 在格拉和奧爾滕貝格之間，矗立著一座不太顯眼但充滿歷史的波斯特施泰因城堡。
dialogue.ja: ゲーラとアルテンベルクの間に、目立たないけれど歴史に満ちたポスターシュタイン城が建っています。
dialogue.local: Between Gera and Altenberg it stands, rather inconspicuous but full of history, posterstein castle.
dialogue.en: Between Gera and Altenberg it stands, rather inconspicuous but full of history, posterstein castle.

dialogue.text: Since the Middle Ages it has overlooked the valley, at times a seat of power, at times an administrative centre.
dialogue.zh: 自中世以來，它俯瞰著山谷，有時是權力的中心，有時是行政中心。
dialogue.ja: 中世以来、この城は谷を見下ろし、時には権力の座、時には行政の中心地でした。
dialogue.local: Since the Middle Ages it has overlooked the valley, at times a seat of power, at times an administrative centre.
dialogue.en: Since the Middle Ages it has overlooked the valley, at times a seat of power, at times an administrative centre.

dialogue.text: Castle posterstein reflects upon a turbulent and eventful historical past.
dialogue.zh: 波斯特施泰因城堡反映出一段動盪且多事的歷史過往。
dialogue.ja: ポスターシュタイン城は、波乱に満ちた歴史を物語っています。
dialogue.local: Castle posterstein reflects upon a turbulent and eventful historical past.
dialogue.en: Castle posterstein reflects upon a turbulent and eventful historical past.

dialogue.text: As early as the 6th century Slavic tribes began to expand their settlement area further west, reaching the Elba and Sala rivers.
dialogue.zh: 早在6世紀，斯拉夫部落開始向西擴展他們的定居區，達到易北河和薩拉河。
dialogue.ja: 6世紀にはすでにスラブ族が西へと勢力を拡大し、エルベ川やザラ川にまで達しました。
dialogue.local: As early as the 6th century Slavic tribes began to expand their settlement area further west, reaching the Elba and Sala rivers.
dialogue.en: As early as the 6th century Slavic tribes began to expand their settlement area further west, reaching the Elba and Sala rivers.

dialogue.text: During this period Slavic groups also settled in what is now the Altenberg land.
dialogue.zh: 在此期間，斯拉夫族群也定居於現今的奧爾滕貝格地區。
dialogue.ja: この時期、スラブの集団は現在のアルテンベルク地方にも定住しました。
dialogue.local: During this period Slavic groups also settled in what is now the Altenberg land.
dialogue.en: During this period Slavic groups also settled in what is now the Altenberg land.

dialogue.text: The Germanic farmers living here were gradually assimilated into the Slavic tribal communities over time.
dialogue.zh: 居住於此的日耳曼農民隨著時間逐漸融入斯拉夫部落社群。
dialogue.ja: ここに住んでいたゲルマンの農民は、徐々にスラブの部族社会に同化していきました。
dialogue.local: The Germanic farmers living here were gradually assimilated into the Slavic tribal communities over time.
dialogue.en: The Germanic farmers living here were gradually assimilated into the Slavic tribal communities over time.

dialogue.text: Thus the Altenberg land early on became part of the Slavic influenced cultural landscape.
dialogue.zh: 因此，奧爾滕貝格地區早期成為受斯拉夫文化影響的文化景觀一部分。
dialogue.ja: こうしてアルテンベルク地方は早くもスラブ文化の影響を受けた地域となりました。
dialogue.local: Thus the Altenberg land early on became part of the Slavic influenced cultural landscape.
dialogue.en: Thus the Altenberg land early on became part of the Slavic influenced cultural landscape.

dialogue.text: Sorbian tribes made use of the treeless lands for farming and herding livestock.
dialogue.zh: 索布族利用無樹之地進行農耕和放牧。
dialogue.ja: ソルブ族は樹木の少ない土地を農業や家畜の放牧に利用しました。
dialogue.local: Sorbian tribes made use of the treeless lands for farming and herding livestock.
dialogue.en: Sorbian tribes made use of the treeless lands for farming and herding livestock.

dialogue.text: The roots of posterstein castle trace back to the time of Emperor Frederick I.
dialogue.zh: 波斯特施泰因城堡的起源可追溯至腓特烈一世皇帝時代。
dialogue.ja: ポスターシュタイン城の起源はフリードリヒ1世皇帝の時代にさかのぼります。
dialogue.local: The roots of posterstein castle trace back to the time of Emperor Frederick I.
dialogue.en: The roots of posterstein castle trace back to the time of Emperor Frederick I.

dialogue.text: In the mid-12th century the stalfa began to expand their sphere of power into the area of what is now the Altenberg region.
dialogue.zh: 12世紀中葉，斯塔爾法開始將勢力擴展到現今的奧爾滕貝格地區。
dialogue.ja: 12世紀半ばにスタルファ家は現在のアルテンベルク地域へと勢力圏を拡大し始めました。
dialogue.local: In the mid-12th century the stalfa began to expand their sphere of power into the area of what is now the Altenberg region.
dialogue.en: In the mid-12th century the stalfa began to expand their sphere of power into the area of what is now the Altenberg region.

dialogue.text: To consolidate their rule there, Barbarossa pursued a strategy.
dialogue.zh: 為鞏固統治，巴巴羅薩採取了一項策略。
dialogue.ja: バルバロッサはそこでの支配を確立するために戦略を取りました。
dialogue.local: To consolidate their rule there, Barbarossa pursued a strategy.
dialogue.en: To consolidate their rule there, Barbarossa pursued a strategy.

dialogue.text: He elevated his ministerials or unfree servants to the rank of knights.
dialogue.zh: 他將他的部屬或非自由僕從提升為騎士階級。
dialogue.ja: 彼は家臣や非自由身分の使用人を騎士の地位に昇格させました。
dialogue.local: He elevated his ministerials or unfree servants to the rank of knights.
dialogue.en: He elevated his ministerials or unfree servants to the rank of knights.

dialogue.text: Their responsibility was to manage the newly settled territories, suppress Slavic influences, and maintain the land's military security.
dialogue.zh: 他們的責任是管理新開墾的領地，壓制斯拉夫影響，並維護土地的軍事安全。
dialogue.ja: 彼らの任務は新たに開拓された領土を管理し、スラブの影響を抑え、土地の軍事的安全を守ることでした。
dialogue.local: Their responsibility was to manage the newly settled territories, suppress Slavic influences, and maintain the land's military security.
dialogue.en: Their responsibility was to manage the newly settled territories, suppress Slavic influences, and maintain the land's military security.

dialogue.text: Thus in the 12th and 13th centuries numerous smaller fortifications emerged in the Pleisenland.
dialogue.zh: 因此在12和13世紀，普萊森蘭地區出現了許多小型防禦工事。
dialogue.ja: こうして12世紀から13世紀にかけて、プライゼンランドには多くの小さな要塞が築かれました。
dialogue.local: Thus in the 12th and 13th centuries numerous smaller fortifications emerged in the Pleisenland.
dialogue.en: Thus in the 12th and 13th centuries numerous smaller fortifications emerged in the Pleisenland.

dialogue.text: One such site was posterstein castle.
dialogue.zh: 其中一處就是波斯特施泰因城堡。
dialogue.ja: その一つがポスターシュタイン城でした。
dialogue.local: One such site was posterstein castle.
dialogue.en: One such site was posterstein castle.

dialogue.text: The first documented mention of the castle dates back to 1191.
dialogue.zh: 城堡首次有文獻記載是在1191年。
dialogue.ja: 城の最初の記録は1191年に遡ります。
dialogue.local: The first documented mention of the castle dates back to 1191.
dialogue.en: The first documented mention of the castle dates back to 1191.

dialogue.text: At that time a Gerhardus of Nurbdinitz, along with his mother, Mechtilde of Stein, is recorded as the owner.
dialogue.zh: 當時，記錄中城堡的擁有者是努爾布迪尼茨的格哈爾杜斯和他的母親斯坦的梅希爾德。
dialogue.ja: その時、ヌルブディニッツのゲルハルトゥスと彼の母メヒティルデ・フォン・シュタインが所有者として記録されています。
dialogue.local: At that time a Gerhardus of Nurbdinitz, along with his mother, Mechtilde of Stein, is recorded as the owner.
dialogue.en: At that time a Gerhardus of Nurbdinitz, along with his mother, Mechtilde of Stein, is recorded as the owner.

dialogue.text: Gerhardus was among the Imperial Ministerials of Emperor Barbarossa.
dialogue.zh: 格哈爾杜斯是巴巴羅薩皇帝的帝國部屬之一。
dialogue.ja: ゲルハルトゥスはバルバロッサ皇帝の帝国家臣の一人でした。
dialogue.local: Gerhardus was among the Imperial Ministerials of Emperor Barbarossa.
dialogue.en: Gerhardus was among the Imperial Ministerials of Emperor Barbarossa.

dialogue.text: The castle itself was built in the Middle Ages as a fortification on a rocky outcrop above the river's broader, a tributary of the Pleis.
dialogue.zh: 城堡本身建於中世，位於一處岩石突出地上，俯瞰著普萊斯河的支流。
dialogue.ja: 城は中世に、プライス川の支流の広がる岩の突き出た場所に築かれた要塞でした。
dialogue.local: The castle itself was built in the Middle Ages as a fortification on a rocky outcrop above the river's broader, a tributary of the Pleis.
dialogue.en: The castle itself was built in the Middle Ages as a fortification on a rocky outcrop above the river's broader, a tributary of the Pleis.

dialogue.text: In the documents of that time it is recorded under the name Stein.
dialogue.zh: 當時的文件中記錄此地名為斯坦。
dialogue.ja: 当時の文書では「シュタイン」という名前で記録されています。
dialogue.local: In the documents of that time it is recorded under the name Stein.
dialogue.en: In the documents of that time it is recorded under the name Stein.

dialogue.text: From this early period parts of the ring wall and the imposing keep have survived and remained intact to this day.
dialogue.zh: 從這個早期時期，部分環牆和雄偉的主塔至今仍保存完好。
dialogue.ja: この初期の時代から、環状の城壁の一部と堂々とした天守は今日まで残っています。
dialogue.local: From this early period parts of the ring wall and the imposing keep have survived and remained intact to this day.
dialogue.en: From this early period parts of the ring wall and the imposing keep have survived and remained intact to this day.

dialogue.text: Later the medieval structure was expanded and rebuilt in the Renaissance style.
dialogue.zh: 後來，中世結構被擴建並以文藝復興風格重建。
dialogue.ja: その後、中世の建物は拡張され、ルネサンス様式で再建されました。
dialogue.local: Later the medieval structure was expanded and rebuilt in the Renaissance style.
dialogue.en: Later the medieval structure was expanded and rebuilt in the Renaissance style.

dialogue.text: On the eastern side a Zwinger was added providing additional protection.
dialogue.zh: 東側增建了外堡，提供額外防護。
dialogue.ja: 東側にはツヴィンガーが追加され、さらなる防御が施されました。
dialogue.local: On the eastern side a Zwinger was added providing additional protection.
dialogue.en: On the eastern side a Zwinger was added providing additional protection.

dialogue.text: In the year 1422 nickel-poster acquired the castle.
dialogue.zh: 1422年，尼克爾·波斯特取得了城堡。
dialogue.ja: 1422年にニッケル・ポスターが城を取得しました。
dialogue.local: In the year 1422 nickel-poster acquired the castle.
dialogue.en: In the year 1422 nickel-poster acquired the castle.

dialogue.text: In the Altonburg Register his family is listed as poster Zumstein.
dialogue.zh: 在奧爾滕堡登記冊中，他的家族被列為波斯特·祖姆施泰因。
dialogue.ja: アルトンブルクの記録では、彼の家族はポスター・ツムシュタインとして記載されています。
dialogue.local: In the Altonburg Register his family is listed as poster Zumstein.
dialogue.en: In the Altonburg Register his family is listed as poster Zumstein.

dialogue.text: During this period the appearance of the complex changed significantly.
dialogue.zh: 在此期間，建築群的外觀發生了顯著變化。
dialogue.ja: この時期に建物の外観は大きく変わりました。
dialogue.local: During this period the appearance of the complex changed significantly.
dialogue.en: During this period the appearance of the complex changed significantly.

dialogue.text: The former fortification gradually transformed into a residential castle.
dialogue.zh: 原本的防禦工事逐漸轉變為住宅城堡。
dialogue.ja: かつての要塞は徐々に居住用の城へと変わっていきました。
dialogue.local: The former fortification gradually transformed into a residential castle.
dialogue.en: The former fortification gradually transformed into a residential castle.

dialogue.text: The castle underwent numerous renovations making it more comfortable and representative.
dialogue.zh: 城堡經過多次翻修，變得更加舒適且具代表性。
dialogue.ja: 城は何度も改修され、より快適で格式のあるものになりました。
dialogue.local: The castle underwent numerous renovations making it more comfortable and representative.
dialogue.en: The castle underwent numerous renovations making it more comfortable and representative.

dialogue.text: And even though it was officially called simply stone until the 16th century it owes its current name to the Poster family.
dialogue.zh: 儘管直到16世紀官方名稱仍是“石頭”，但它現在的名字來自波斯特家族。
dialogue.ja: 16世紀まで正式には「シュタイン」と呼ばれていましたが、現在の名前はポスター家に由来します。
dialogue.local: And even though it was officially called simply stone until the 16th century it owes its current name to the Poster family.
dialogue.en: And even though it was officially called simply stone until the 16th century it owes its current name to the Poster family.

dialogue.text: Because from Poster Zumstein came poster steam.
dialogue.zh: 因為從波斯特·祖姆施泰因演變成了波斯特施泰因。
dialogue.ja: ポスター・ツムシュタインからポスターシュタインという名前が生まれました。
dialogue.local: Because from Poster Zumstein came poster steam.
dialogue.en: Because from Poster Zumstein came poster steam.

dialogue.text: In the 16th century the castle acquired its characteristic appearance that remains to this day.
dialogue.zh: 16世紀，城堡獲得了至今仍保留的特色外觀。
dialogue.ja: 16世紀に城は現在も残る特徴的な外観を得ました。
dialogue.local: In the 16th century the castle acquired its characteristic appearance that remains to this day.
dialogue.en: In the 16th century the castle acquired its characteristic appearance that remains to this day.

dialogue.text: The facade was coated with white plaster, the corners accentuated in vibrant red.
dialogue.zh: 外牆塗上白色灰泥，角落以鮮紅色強調。
dialogue.ja: 外壁は白い漆喰で覆われ、角は鮮やかな赤で強調されました。
dialogue.local: The facade was coated with white plaster, the corners accentuated in vibrant red.
dialogue.en: The facade was coated with white plaster, the corners accentuated in vibrant red.

dialogue.text: A clear sign of the transition from a fortress to a residential castle.
dialogue.zh: 這明顯標誌著從堡壘向住宅城堡的轉變。
dialogue.ja: これは要塞から居住用の城への移行の明確なサインです。
dialogue.local: A clear sign of the transition from a fortress to a residential castle.
dialogue.en: A clear sign of the transition from a fortress to a residential castle.

dialogue.text: Also dating back to this period is an architectural highlight, the arch on the west side.
dialogue.zh: 同時期的建築亮點還有西側的拱門。
dialogue.ja: この時代の建築の見どころとして、西側のアーチがあります。
dialogue.local: Also dating back to this period is an architectural highlight, the arch on the west side.
dialogue.en: Also dating back to this period is an architectural highlight, the arch on the west side.

dialogue.text: It rests on four exquisitely arranged vaulted consoles, a true masterpiece of Renaissance architecture that remarkably transformed and elevated the once plain fortification.
dialogue.zh: 它由四個精美排列的拱形托架支撐，是文藝復興建築的真跡，顯著改造並提升了曾經樸素的防禦工事。
dialogue.ja: それは4つの美しく配置されたヴォールトコンソールの上にあり、かつての質素な要塞を見事に変貌させたルネサンス建築の傑作です。
dialogue.local: It rests on four exquisitely arranged vaulted consoles, a true masterpiece of Renaissance architecture that remarkably transformed and elevated the once plain fortification.
dialogue.en: It rests on four exquisitely arranged vaulted consoles, a true masterpiece of Renaissance architecture that remarkably transformed and elevated the once plain fortification.

dialogue.text: Originally, Poster Stein Castle was built as a classic ring fort with a central keep at its core.
dialogue.zh: 波斯特施泰因城堡最初建成為典型的環形堡壘，中央有主塔。
dialogue.ja: ポスターシュタイン城はもともと中央に天守を持つ典型的な環状要塞として建てられました。
dialogue.local: Originally, Poster Stein Castle was built as a classic ring fort with a central keep at its core.
dialogue.en: Originally, Poster Stein Castle was built as a classic ring fort with a central keep at its core.

dialogue.text: Today this tower saws all the way to the weather vein standing at 42 meters tall.
dialogue.zh: 如今這座塔高42米，直達風向標。
dialogue.ja: 現在、この塔は42メートルの高さで風見鶏までそびえています。
dialogue.local: Today this tower saws all the way to the weather vein standing at 42 meters tall.
dialogue.en: Today this tower saws all the way to the weather vein standing at 42 meters tall.

dialogue.text: The old defensive platform is thought to have been situated near today's viewing platform.
dialogue.zh: 舊防禦平台據信位於現今的觀景台附近。
dialogue.ja: 古い防御用のプラットフォームは現在の展望台の近くにあったと考えられています。
dialogue.local: The old defensive platform is thought to have been situated near today's viewing platform.
dialogue.en: The old defensive platform is thought to have been situated near today's viewing platform.

dialogue.text: Yet its precise medieval form, whether with battlements or a roof, can't be reconstructed today.
dialogue.zh: 然而其精確的中世形態，不論是有垛口或屋頂，今天已無法重建。
dialogue.ja: しかし、中世の正確な形状、垛や屋根の有無は今日では再現できません。
dialogue.local: Yet its precise medieval form, whether with battlements or a roof, can't be reconstructed today.
dialogue.en: Yet its precise medieval form, whether with battlements or a roof, can't be reconstructed today.

dialogue.text: Too many renovations altered the appearance over the course of the centuries.
dialogue.zh: 數世紀以來的多次翻修改變了其外觀。
dialogue.ja: 何世紀にもわたる改修が外観を変えてしまいました。
dialogue.local: Too many renovations altered the appearance over the course of the centuries.
dialogue.en: Too many renovations altered the appearance over the course of the centuries.

dialogue.text: The distinctive structure with the conical roof, which is now considered the landmark of the castle, dates back to the year 1888.
dialogue.zh: 帶錐形屋頂的獨特建築，現為城堡地標，可追溯至1888年。
dialogue.ja: 現在城のランドマークとされる円錐形の屋根を持つ特徴的な建物は1888年のものです。
dialogue.local: The distinctive structure with the conical roof, which is now considered the landmark of the castle, dates back to the year 1888.
dialogue.en: The distinctive structure with the conical roof, which is now considered the landmark of the castle, dates back to the year 1888.

dialogue.text: In times of greatest danger, the keep offered the last safe refuge for the castle's inhabitants, as well as for the people from the surrounding villages.
dialogue.zh: 在最危急時刻，主塔為城堡居民及周邊村民提供最後的安全避難所。
dialogue.ja: 最も危険な時には、天守は城の住民や周辺の村人たちの最後の安全な避難所となりました。
dialogue.local: In times of greatest danger, the keep offered the last safe refuge for the castle's inhabitants, as well as for the people from the surrounding villages.
dialogue.en: In times of greatest danger, the keep offered the last safe refuge for the castle's inhabitants, as well as for the people from the surrounding villages.

dialogue.text: Behind its three meter thick walls, they could seek safety and refuge.
dialogue.zh: 在三米厚的牆壁後，他們可以尋求安全和庇護。
dialogue.ja: 厚さ3メートルの壁の内側で、安全と避難所を得ることができました。
dialogue.local: Behind its three meter thick walls, they could seek safety and refuge.
dialogue.en: Behind its three meter thick walls, they could seek safety and refuge.

dialogue.text: The original entrance, well protected from attack, was positioned on the side away from the enemy, 12 meters above ground.
dialogue.zh: 原始入口設於遠離敵方的一側，距地面12米，防禦良好。
dialogue.ja: 元の入口は攻撃から守られ、敵から離れた側にあり、地上12メートルの高さにありました。
dialogue.local: The original entrance, well protected from attack, was positioned on the side away from the enemy, 12 meters above ground.
dialogue.en: The original entrance, well protected from attack, was positioned on the side away from the enemy, 12 meters above ground.

dialogue.text: It's possible that back then one could only enter via a rope ladder.
dialogue.zh: 當時可能只能透過繩梯進入。
dialogue.ja: 当時はロープのはしごでしか入れなかった可能性があります。
dialogue.local: It's possible that back then one could only enter via a rope ladder.
dialogue.en: It's possible that back then one could only enter via a rope ladder.

dialogue.text: A visible ledge in the masonry suggests that during the middle ages, a wooden beam ceiling had been installed at this spot.
dialogue.zh: 磚石中可見的突出部分顯示中世時期此處曾裝有木樑天花板。
dialogue.ja: 石造りの壁に見える出っ張りは、中世にこの場所に木製の梁の天井があったことを示しています。
dialogue.local: A visible ledge in the masonry suggests that during the middle ages, a wooden beam ceiling had been installed at this spot.
dialogue.en: A visible ledge in the masonry suggests that during the middle ages, a wooden beam ceiling had been installed at this spot.

dialogue.text: Part of an intermediate floor once inside the tower.
dialogue.zh: 曾是塔內中間樓層的一部分。
dialogue.ja: これは塔の中の中間階の一部でした。
dialogue.local: Part of an intermediate floor once inside the tower.
dialogue.en: Part of an intermediate floor once inside the tower.

dialogue.text: On several intermediate floors, people could set up makeshift arrangements in the keep to wait out the siege's end.
dialogue.zh: 在數個中間樓層，人們可以在主塔內設置臨時設施以等待圍城結束。
dialogue.ja: いくつかの中間階では、包囲戦の終わりを待つための臨時の設備を設けることができました。
dialogue.local: On several intermediate floors, people could set up makeshift arrangements in the keep to wait out the siege's end.
dialogue.en: On several intermediate floors, people could set up makeshift arrangements in the keep to wait out the siege's end.

dialogue.text: Back then, the tower still stood free in the centre of the fortification, without direct connection to the adjacent buildings.
dialogue.zh: 當時，塔仍獨立矗立於防禦工事中心，未與鄰近建築直接相連。
dialogue.ja: 当時、塔は要塞の中心に独立して立っており、隣接する建物とは直接つながっていませんでした。
dialogue.local: Back then, the tower still stood free in the centre of the fortification, without direct connection to the adjacent buildings.
dialogue.en: Back then, the tower still stood free in the centre of the fortification, without direct connection to the adjacent buildings.

dialogue.text: That's precisely what made it the safest spot in the castle.
dialogue.zh: 這正是使其成為城堡中最安全地點的原因。
dialogue.ja: それがこの塔を城で最も安全な場所にしていました。
dialogue.local: That's precisely what made it the safest spot in the castle.
dialogue.en: That's precisely what made it the safest spot in the castle.

dialogue.text: Once barricaded inside, they were incredibly hard to overcome.
dialogue.zh: 一旦被封鎖在內，敵人極難攻破。
dialogue.ja: 一度中にバリケードを築くと、突破するのは非常に困難でした。
dialogue.local: Once barricaded inside, they were incredibly hard to overcome.
dialogue.en: Once barricaded inside, they were incredibly hard to overcome.

dialogue.text: Often attackers had no choice but to try to starve out the occupants or force them to surrender through smoke and fire.
dialogue.zh: 攻擊者常常只能選擇用飢餓或煙火迫使守軍投降。
dialogue.ja: 攻撃者はしばしば、住人を飢えさせたり、煙や火で降伏を強いるしかありませんでした。
dialogue.local: Often attackers had no choice but to try to starve out the occupants or force them to surrender through smoke and fire.
dialogue.en: Often attackers had no choice but to try to starve out the occupants or force them to surrender through smoke and fire.

dialogue.text: In the event of an attack, the keep was not only a retreat, but also the strategically best place for defence.
dialogue.zh: 遭受攻擊時，主塔不僅是撤退處，也是戰略上最佳防禦點。
dialogue.ja: 攻撃の際、天守は退避場所であるだけでなく、防御に最も適した戦略的な場所でした。
dialogue.local: In the event of an attack, the keep was not only a retreat, but also the strategically best place for defence.
dialogue.en: In the event of an attack, the keep was not only a retreat, but also the strategically best place for defence.

dialogue.text: From up here, a watchman kept an eye out for approaching enemies, as soon as danger loomed, the defenders would take their positions.
dialogue.zh: 守望者從高處監視敵人，一旦危險逼近，防守者便就位。
dialogue.ja: ここから見張りが敵の接近を監視し、危険が迫ると守備隊が配置につきました。
dialogue.local: From up here, a watchman kept an eye out for approaching enemies, as soon as danger loomed, the defenders would take their positions.
dialogue.en: From up here, a watchman kept an eye out for approaching enemies, as soon as danger loomed, the defenders would take their positions.

dialogue.text: With bows and arrows or with crossbows, they fired through narrow loopholes in the wall at the attackers.
dialogue.zh: 他們用弓箭或弩從牆上的狹縫射擊攻擊者。
dialogue.ja: 弓矢やクロスボウで壁の狭い狙撃孔から攻撃者を射撃しました。
dialogue.local: With bows and arrows or with crossbows, they fired through narrow loopholes in the wall at the attackers.
dialogue.en: With bows and arrows or with crossbows, they fired through narrow loopholes in the wall at the attackers.

dialogue.text: Battlements and a sturdy protective parapet provided them with reliable cover,
dialogue.zh: 垛口和堅固的護欄為他們提供了可靠的掩護，
dialogue.ja: 胸壁と頑丈な防護柵が彼らに確かな隠れ場所を提供しました。
dialogue.local: Battlements and a sturdy protective parapet provided them with reliable cover,
dialogue.en: Battlements and a sturdy protective parapet provided them with reliable cover,

dialogue.text: and if the enemy advanced too closely, there was another tactic, hurling heavy stones straight down from above.
dialogue.zh: 如果敵人逼近，還有另一策略：從上方直接投擲重石。
dialogue.ja: 敵が近づきすぎた場合は、上から重い石を投げ落とす戦術もありました。
dialogue.local: and if the enemy advanced too closely, there was another tactic, hurling heavy stones straight down from above.
dialogue.en: and if the enemy advanced too closely, there was another tactic, hurling heavy stones straight down from above.

dialogue.text: Since the 16th century, the name Fluke has regularly appeared in the ownership records of numerous manners in the region.
dialogue.zh: 自16世紀起，弗魯克家族的名字經常出現在該地區多處莊園的所有權記錄中。
dialogue.ja: 16世紀以降、フルーク家の名前はこの地域の多くの領地の所有記録に頻繁に登場しました。
dialogue.local: Since the 16th century, the name Fluke has regularly appeared in the ownership records of numerous manners in the region.
dialogue.en: Since the 16th century, the name Fluke has regularly appeared in the ownership records of numerous manners in the region.

dialogue.text: The family was no minor noble lineage.
dialogue.zh: 這個家族並非小貴族世家。
dialogue.ja: この家族は小さな貴族の家系ではありませんでした。
dialogue.local: The family was no minor noble lineage.
dialogue.en: The family was no minor noble lineage.

dialogue.text: In the year 1528, a highly significant and impactful sale took place.
dialogue.zh: 1528年，發生了一次極具意義且影響深遠的出售。
dialogue.ja: 1528年に非常に重要で影響力のある売却が行われました。
dialogue.local: In the year 1528, a highly significant and impactful sale took place.
dialogue.en: In the year 1528, a highly significant and impactful sale took place.

dialogue.text: Nickel von Ender, former lord of poster Stein sold the family's 14th century holding.
dialogue.zh: 波斯特施泰因前領主尼克爾·馮·恩德出售了家族14世紀的產業。
dialogue.ja: ポスターシュタインの元領主ニッケル・フォン・エンダーが家族の14世紀の所領を売却しました。
dialogue.local: Nickel von Ender, former lord of poster Stein sold the family's 14th century holding.
dialogue.en: Nickel von Ender, former lord of poster Stein sold the family's 14th century holding.

dialogue.text: A knight's estate held as a reunion thief since the century with all its possessions.
dialogue.zh: 這是一處騎士莊園，自世紀以來一直作為家族產業持有，包含所有財產。
dialogue.ja: 騎士の領地であり、世紀以来家族の所有物として保有されていました。
dialogue.local: A knight's estate held as a reunion thief since the century with all its possessions.
dialogue.en: A knight's estate held as a reunion thief since the century with all its possessions.

dialogue.text: For the proud sum of 17,500 guilders, the buyers were his forefathers, the brothers von Fluke from Aitra of the Myson noble lineage.
dialogue.zh: 以驕傲的17500古爾登價格，買家是他的祖先，來自艾特拉的邁森貴族血統弗魯克兄弟。
dialogue.ja: 誇らしい17500グルデンの価格で、買い手は彼の先祖であり、アイトラ出身のマイセン貴族のフルーク兄弟でした。
dialogue.local: For the proud sum of 17,500 guilders, the buyers were his forefathers, the brothers von Fluke from Aitra of the Myson noble lineage.
dialogue.en: For the proud sum of 17,500 guilders, the buyers were his forefathers, the brothers von Fluke from Aitra of the Myson noble lineage.

dialogue.text: Thus began the era of the Fluke family at posterstein.
dialogue.zh: 由此開始了弗魯克家族在波斯特施泰因的時代。
dialogue.ja: こうしてポスターシュタインにおけるフルーク家の時代が始まりました。
dialogue.local: Thus began the era of the Fluke family at posterstein.
dialogue.en: Thus began the era of the Fluke family at posterstein.

dialogue.text: A family whose influence would shape the history of the region for generations to come.
dialogue.zh: 這個家族的影響將塑造該地區未來數代的歷史。
dialogue.ja: この家族の影響は、今後何世代にもわたって地域の歴史を形作ることになります。
dialogue.local: A family whose influence would shape the history of the region for generations to come.
dialogue.en: A family whose influence would shape the history of the region for generations to come.

dialogue.text: There are particularly several historical accounts about Julius and how bald flew.
dialogue.zh: 關於尤利烏斯和霍爾德·弗魯克有多則歷史記載。
dialogue.ja: 特にユリウスとホルド・フルークに関するいくつかの歴史的記録があります。
dialogue.local: There are particularly several historical accounts about Julius and how bald flew.
dialogue.en: There are particularly several historical accounts about Julius and how bald flew.

dialogue.text: Julius became the bishop in Namburg.
dialogue.zh: 尤利烏斯成為南堡的主教。
dialogue.ja: ユリウスはナムブルクの司教になりました。
dialogue.local: Julius became the bishop in Namburg.
dialogue.en: Julius became the bishop in Namburg.

dialogue.text: The highly learned man was considered a significant opponent of the reformer.
dialogue.zh: 這位博學之士被視為宗教改革者的重要對手。
dialogue.ja: この博識な人物は宗教改革者の重要な対抗者と見なされていました。
dialogue.local: The highly learned man was considered a significant opponent of the reformer.
dialogue.en: The highly learned man was considered a significant opponent of the reformer.

dialogue.text: How bald on the other hand entered the civil service of his sovereign, elected John Frederick, and took on the duties of knighthood.
dialogue.zh: 而霍爾德則進入其君主約翰·弗雷德里克的公務體系，承擔騎士職責。
dialogue.ja: 一方でホルドは、選出された君主ヨハン・フリードリヒの公務に就き、騎士の職務を担いました。
dialogue.local: How bald on the other hand entered the civil service of his sovereign, elected John Frederick, and took on the duties of knighthood.
dialogue.en: How bald on the other hand entered the civil service of his sovereign, elected John Frederick, and took on the duties of knighthood.

dialogue.text: Thus, in the Schmalchaldic war, four horses, a military wagon, two archers, and a pike man from posterstein were deployed.
dialogue.zh: 因此，在施馬爾卡爾德戰爭中，波斯特施泰因派出了四匹馬、一輛軍用馬車、兩名弓箭手和一名長矛兵。
dialogue.ja: こうしてシュマルカルデン戦争では、ポスターシュタインから4頭の馬、軍用ワゴン1台、弓兵2人、槍兵1人が派遣されました。
dialogue.local: Thus, in the Schmalchaldic war, four horses, a military wagon, two archers, and a pike man from posterstein were deployed.
dialogue.en: Thus, in the Schmalchaldic war, four horses, a military wagon, two archers, and a pike man from posterstein were deployed.

dialogue.text: The manner expanded over time, and the castle was transformed into a grand palace.
dialogue.zh: 莊園隨著時間擴大，城堡也轉變成宏偉的宮殿。
dialogue.ja: 領地は時間とともに拡大し、城は壮大な宮殿へと変貌しました。
dialogue.local: The manner expanded over time, and the castle was transformed into a grand palace.
dialogue.en: The manner expanded over time, and the castle was transformed into a grand palace.

dialogue.text: In the year 1554, how bald von Fluke significantly expanded his influence.
dialogue.zh: 1554年，霍爾德·馮·弗魯克大幅擴展了他的影響力。
dialogue.ja: 1554年にホルド・フォン・フルークはその影響力を大きく拡大しました。
dialogue.local: In the year 1554, how bald von Fluke significantly expanded his influence.
dialogue.en: In the year 1554, how bald von Fluke significantly expanded his influence.

dialogue.text: He acquired jurisdiction over 14 additional locations.
dialogue.zh: 他獲得了對另外14個地點的司法管轄權。
dialogue.ja: 彼はさらに14の地域に対する司法権を獲得しました。
dialogue.local: He acquired jurisdiction over 14 additional locations.
dialogue.en: He acquired jurisdiction over 14 additional locations.

dialogue.text: The lower jurisdiction governed every day matters, guardianships, inheritances, and sales.
dialogue.zh: 下級司法管轄處理日常事務、監護權、繼承和銷售。
dialogue.ja: 下級司法権は日常の問題、後見、相続、売買を扱いました。
dialogue.local: The lower jurisdiction governed every day matters, guardianships, inheritances, and sales.
dialogue.en: The lower jurisdiction governed every day matters, guardianships, inheritances, and sales.

dialogue.text: The higher jurisdiction, however, extended much further.
dialogue.zh: 然而，高級司法管轄範圍更廣。
dialogue.ja: しかし上級司法権ははるかに広範囲に及びました。
dialogue.local: The higher jurisdiction, however, extended much further.
dialogue.en: The higher jurisdiction, however, extended much further.

dialogue.text: It permitted judgments over life and limb, essentially deciding matters of life and death.
dialogue.zh: 它允許對生死作出判決，實質上決定生死大事。
dialogue.ja: それは生命や身体に関わる判決を下す権限を持ち、実質的に生死を決定しました。
dialogue.local: It permitted judgments over life and limb, essentially deciding matters of life and death.
dialogue.en: It permitted judgments over life and limb, essentially deciding matters of life and death.

dialogue.text: A fascinating relic from that time is still preserved in the courtroom of the castle.
dialogue.zh: 當時一件迷人的遺物仍保存在城堡的法庭中。
dialogue.ja: 当時の興味深い遺物が城の法廷に今も保存されています。
dialogue.local: A fascinating relic from that time is still preserved in the courtroom of the castle.
dialogue.en: A fascinating relic from that time is still preserved in the courtroom of the castle.

dialogue.text: A massive court cabinet from the 17th century firmly built into the room.
dialogue.zh: 一個17世紀的大型法院櫃牢牢嵌入房間內。
dialogue.ja: 17世紀の巨大な裁判所のキャビネットが部屋にしっかりと組み込まれています。
dialogue.local: A massive court cabinet from the 17th century firmly built into the room.
dialogue.en: A massive court cabinet from the 17th century firmly built into the room.

dialogue.text: Behind its three signed doors, files and court books were once securely stored for safekeeping, especially intriguing.
dialogue.zh: 在其三扇有鎖的門後，曾安全存放著檔案和法庭書籍，尤其引人入勝。
dialogue.ja: 3つの鍵付き扉の後ろには、かつて書類や裁判所の書籍が安全に保管されていました。特に興味深いのは、
dialogue.local: Behind its three signed doors, files and court books were once securely stored for safekeeping, especially intriguing.
dialogue.en: Behind its three signed doors, files and court books were once securely stored for safekeeping, especially intriguing.

dialogue.text: The cabinet hides a staircase.
dialogue.zh: 櫃子內藏有一條樓梯。
dialogue.ja: そのキャビネットには階段が隠されています。
dialogue.local: The cabinet hides a staircase.
dialogue.en: The cabinet hides a staircase.

dialogue.text: Castle dwellers likely used this passage as a secret escape route.
dialogue.zh: 城堡居民很可能利用這條通道作為秘密逃生路線。
dialogue.ja: 城の住人はこの通路を秘密の脱出経路として使っていた可能性があります。
dialogue.local: Castle dwellers likely used this passage as a secret escape route.
dialogue.en: Castle dwellers likely used this passage as a secret escape route.

dialogue.text: It led from the courtroom to the kitchen, into the courtyard, the lower hall with the chapel, and even down to the deep cellar of the castle.
dialogue.zh: 它從法庭通往廚房、庭院、帶有禮拜堂的下層大廳，甚至深入城堡的深地窖。
dialogue.ja: それは法廷から台所、庭、礼拝堂のある下のホール、さらには城の深い地下室へと続いていました。
dialogue.local: It led from the courtroom to the kitchen, into the courtyard, the lower hall with the chapel, and even down to the deep cellar of the castle.
dialogue.en: It led from the courtroom to the kitchen, into the courtyard, the lower hall with the chapel, and even down to the deep cellar of the castle.

dialogue.text: Towards the end of the 18th century, Schloss Tanenfeld, located just about two kilometers from posterstein, evolved into a hub of intellectual and cultural life in Germany.
dialogue.zh: 18世紀末，距波斯特施泰因約兩公里的塔嫩費爾德宮成為德國知識與文化生活的中心。
dialogue.ja: 18世紀末、ポスターシュタインから約2キロのシュロス・タネンフェルトはドイツの知的・文化的生活の中心地へと発展しました。
dialogue.local: Towards the end of the 18th century, Schloss Tanenfeld, located just about two kilometers from posterstein, evolved into a hub of intellectual and cultural life in Germany.
dialogue.en: Towards the end of the 18th century, Schloss Tanenfeld, located just about two kilometers from posterstein, evolved into a hub of intellectual and cultural life in Germany.

dialogue.text: The so-called mousinhof of Dutch as Anna Dorothea of Corland was among the most renowned of its kind.
dialogue.zh: 被稱為穆辛霍夫的荷蘭人安娜·多蘿西亞·科蘭德是其中最著名的人物之一。
dialogue.ja: いわゆるムージンホフのオランダ人、アンナ・ドロテア・フォン・コーランドはその中でも最も有名な人物の一人でした。
dialogue.local: The so-called mousinhof of Dutch as Anna Dorothea of Corland was among the most renowned of its kind.
dialogue.en: The so-called mousinhof of Dutch as Anna Dorothea of Corland was among the most renowned of its kind.

dialogue.text: She cultivated strong connections with leading statesmen and notable figures of her era.
dialogue.zh: 她與當時的領袖政治家和知名人物建立了密切聯繫。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は当時の有力な政治家や著名人と強い繋がりを築きました。
dialogue.local: She cultivated strong connections with leading statesmen and notable figures of her era.
dialogue.en: She cultivated strong connections with leading statesmen and notable figures of her era.

dialogue.text: In the salons, they not only made music, played games, and debated, but also actively promoted political exchange.
dialogue.zh: 在沙龍中，他們不僅演奏音樂、玩遊戲、辯論，還積極促進政治交流。
dialogue.ja: サロンでは音楽を奏で、ゲームをし、議論を交わすだけでなく、政治的な交流も積極的に促進しました。
dialogue.local: In the salons, they not only made music, played games, and debated, but also actively promoted political exchange.
dialogue.en: In the salons, they not only made music, played games, and debated, but also actively promoted political exchange.

dialogue.text: A fellow poet once remarked with admiration that in her salon, every opinion could be expressed as long as it was conveyed in a courteous manner.
dialogue.zh: 一位詩人曾讚賞地說，在她的沙龍裡，只要禮貌表達，每種意見都能被提出。
dialogue.ja: ある詩人は感嘆して言いました。彼女のサロンでは、礼儀正しく伝えられる限り、どんな意見も表現できました。
dialogue.local: A fellow poet once remarked with admiration that in her salon, every opinion could be expressed as long as it was conveyed in a courteous manner.
dialogue.en: A fellow poet once remarked with admiration that in her salon, every opinion could be expressed as long as it was conveyed in a courteous manner.

dialogue.text: Anna Dorothea von Corland turned her estates and Tanenfeld into meeting points for the European elite.
dialogue.zh: 安娜·多蘿西亞·馮·科蘭德將她的莊園和塔嫩費爾德變成歐洲精英的聚會場所。
dialogue.ja: アンナ・ドロテア・フォン・コーランドは自身の領地とタネンフェルトをヨーロッパのエリートたちの集まる場所にしました。
dialogue.local: Anna Dorothea von Corland turned her estates and Tanenfeld into meeting points for the European elite.
dialogue.en: Anna Dorothea von Corland turned her estates and Tanenfeld into meeting points for the European elite.

dialogue.text: Artists, philosophers, and prominent political figures of her era were welcome to her court.
dialogue.zh: 藝術家、哲學家及當代著名政治人物都受邀至她的宮廷。
dialogue.ja: 芸術家や哲学者、当時の著名な政治家たちが彼女の宮廷に招かれました。
dialogue.local: Artists, philosophers, and prominent political figures of her era were welcome to her court.
dialogue.en: Artists, philosophers, and prominent political figures of her era were welcome to her court.

dialogue.text: Among the most distinguished guests was likely even Tsar Alexander I of Russia.
dialogue.zh: 最傑出的賓客中，可能還包括俄羅斯沙皇亞歷山大一世。
dialogue.ja: 最も著名な客の中には、ロシアのアレクサンドル1世皇帝もいた可能性があります。
dialogue.local: Among the most distinguished guests was likely even Tsar Alexander I of Russia.
dialogue.en: Among the most distinguished guests was likely even Tsar Alexander I of Russia.

dialogue.text: The Duchess deliberately chose the locations of her residences.
dialogue.zh: 公爵夫人刻意選擇她住所的位置。
dialogue.ja: 公爵夫人は意図的に居住地の場所を選びました。
dialogue.local: The Duchess deliberately chose the locations of her residences.
dialogue.en: The Duchess deliberately chose the locations of her residences.

dialogue.text: The two castles were situated along major travel routes, centrally located between Berlin and Karlsbad, between Dresden and Airfoot, and in close proximity to the intellectual hubs of Weimar and Jena at the time.
dialogue.zh: 這兩座城堡位於主要交通路線上，居於柏林與卡爾斯巴德、德勒斯登與艾爾福特之間的中心，且靠近當時的魏瑪與耶拿知識中心。
dialogue.ja: 二つの城は主要な交通路沿いにあり、ベルリンとカールスバート、ドレスデンとエアフートの間の中心に位置し、当時のワイマールとイェーナの知的拠点にも近接していました。
dialogue.local: The two castles were situated along major travel routes, centrally located between Berlin and Karlsbad, between Dresden and Airfoot, and in close proximity to the intellectual hubs of Weimar and Jena at the time.
dialogue.en: The two castles were situated along major travel routes, centrally located between Berlin and Karlsbad, between Dresden and Airfoot, and in close proximity to the intellectual hubs of Weimar and Jena at the time.

dialogue.text: The nearby Ranaburg was also a renowned spa destination during that era.
dialogue.zh: 附近的拉納堡在當時也是著名的溫泉勝地。
dialogue.ja: 近くのラナブルクも当時有名な温泉地でした。
dialogue.local: The nearby Ranaburg was also a renowned spa destination during that era.
dialogue.en: The nearby Ranaburg was also a renowned spa destination during that era.

dialogue.text: Every day life at the court of muses was characterized by openness and culture.
dialogue.zh: 繆斯宮廷的日常生活以開放與文化為特徵。
dialogue.ja: ミューズの宮廷の日常生活は開放性と文化性が特徴でした。
dialogue.local: Every day life at the court of muses was characterized by openness and culture.
dialogue.en: Every day life at the court of muses was characterized by openness and culture.

dialogue.text: A particular highlight was the daily gathering at 5 p.m. in the tea room of Tanenfeld Castle.
dialogue.zh: 一大亮點是每天傍晚5點在塔嫩費爾德城堡茶室的聚會。
dialogue.ja: 特に注目すべきは、毎日午後5時にタネンフェルト城のティールームで開かれる集まりでした。
dialogue.local: A particular highlight was the daily gathering at 5 p.m. in the tea room of Tanenfeld Castle.
dialogue.en: A particular highlight was the daily gathering at 5 p.m. in the tea room of Tanenfeld Castle.

dialogue.text: A philosophized, debated, made music, and danced.
dialogue.zh: 大家哲學討論、辯論、演奏音樂並跳舞。
dialogue.ja: 哲学的な議論を交わし、音楽を奏で、踊りを楽しみました。
dialogue.local: A philosophized, debated, made music, and danced.
dialogue.en: A philosophized, debated, made music, and danced.

dialogue.text: Plays were written and performed together, corrals were composed and presented.
dialogue.zh: 戲劇被共同創作與演出，詩歌也被創作並呈現。
dialogue.ja: 劇が共に書かれ上演され、詩歌も作られ披露されました。
